author: Mihai209
name: chrysalis-os
description: A modern, hackable, and modular x86 operating system.

scripts.build: TCC_REQUIRED=1 yarn tcc:build && make clean && make dirs && make && make iso
scripts.logslivedebug:x64: make all && make iso && sh -c 'yarn ldebugx64 2>&1 | tee serial.log'
scripts.ldebugx64: clear ; make all && make iso && yarn run:iso64
scripts.kernel:check: nm -u build/kernel.bin | grep -v '__' || echo 'No external symbols found.'
scripts.tcc:build: sh -c 'if [ -f ported-langs/C/toolchain/bin/tcc ]; then echo "[TCC] tcc already present"; exit 0; fi; for cc in "$CHRYSALIS_TCC_CC" i386-chrysalis-gcc i386-elf-gcc i686-elf-gcc; do if [ -n "$cc" ] && command -v "$cc" >/dev/null 2>&1; then export CHRYSALIS_TCC_CC="$cc"; echo "[TCC] Using compiler: $cc"; ported-langs/C/toolchain/build_tcc.sh && exit 0; fi; done; echo "[TCC] No Chrysalis cross-compiler found. Set CHRYSALIS_TCC_CC (e.g. i386-chrysalis-gcc)."; if [ "${TCC_REQUIRED:-1}" = "1" ]; then exit 1; else echo "[TCC] Skipping TinyCC build (TCC_REQUIRED=0)"; exit 0; fi'
scripts.installer:run: clear && qemu-system-i386 -audiodev pa,id=snd0 -machine pcspk-audiodev=snd0 -m 512 -smp 2 -boot order=d -cdrom ../installer/installer.iso -serial stdio -drive file=hdd.img,format=raw,if=ide -vga std
scripts.installer:ahci: clear && qemu-system-i386 -audiodev pa,id=snd0 -machine pcspk-audiodev=snd0 -m 512 -smp 2 -boot order=d -cdrom ../installer/installer.iso -serial stdio -drive file=hdd.img,format=raw,if=none,id=disk0 -device ahci,id=ahci -device ide-hd,drive=disk0,bus=ahci.0 -vga std
scripts.installer:log: sh -c 'mkdir -p logs && yarn installer:run | tee logs/installer-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log'
scripts.run:hdd: clear && qemu-system-i386 -audiodev pa,id=snd0 -machine pcspk-audiodev=snd0 -m 512 -smp 2 -boot order=c -serial stdio -drive file=hdd.img,format=raw,if=none,id=disk0 -device ahci,id=ahci -device ide-hd,drive=disk0,bus=ahci.0 -netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device e1000,netdev=net0 -vga std
scripts.run:hdd64: clear && qemu-system-x86_64 -audiodev pa,id=snd0 -machine pcspk-audiodev=snd0 -m 1024 -smp 2 -boot order=c -serial stdio -drive file=hdd.img,format=raw,if=none,id=disk0 -device ahci,id=ahci -device ide-hd,drive=disk0,bus=ahci.0 -netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device e1000,netdev=net0 -vga std
scripts.grub-convert: cd ../ && cd grub-theme && convert background.jpg -resize 1024x768! background.tga && convert select_c.png -resize 600x30! select_c.tga && cd .. && cd os
scripts.nm:check: echo '== Linkage Check ==' && nm -u build/fat_fs.o | grep ata_read_sector || echo 'Linkage OK'
